ns2:course.label: Torts
ns2:course.description: Basic course in civil wrongs, including intentional torts (such as assault and battery), negligence (duty, unreasonable risk analysis, actual and proximate cause), and strict liability. Law students only. 4 professional hours. 4 graduate hours.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Law students only. 4 professional hours. 4 graduate hours.
